# Model Diagnostics

```{r diag-plots, fig.cap = "Residual diagnostics", fig.height = 6}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(fit, pch = ".")
```

```{r diag-tests}
resid_sample <- sample(residuals(fit), 5000)  # shapiro.test allows at most 5000 values
tibble(
  Check = c("Breusch-Pagan (constant variance)",
            "Shapiro-Wilk on 5,000 residuals (normality)"),
  p.value = c(bptest(fit)$p.value, shapiro.test(resid_sample)$p.value)
) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 4, caption = "Assumption tests") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

```{r diag-vif}
vif(fit) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Predictor") |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 2, caption = "Generalized variance inflation factors") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```
